## MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the Current Market Regime?
RISK-ON — low volatility (Vol: 15.9%) and broad participation (Breadth: 6/8 sectors positive).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Banking & Finance leading: HALKB (1W: +11.01% | 1M: +4.15%) ABOVE TREND, AKBNK (1W: +4.05% | 1M: +11.17%) ABOVE TREND, YKBNK (1W: +4.10% | 1M: +13.26%) ABOVE TREND. Energy & Chemicals also strong: TRMET (1W: +8.47% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND, TRALT (1W: +7.82% | 1M: +17.20%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Retail & Food and Technology & Telecom lag: ULKER (1W: -5.68% | 1M: +2.73%) CORRECTION, CCOLA (1W: -3.72% | 1M: -14.09%) BELOW TREND, KONTR (1W: -5.32% | 1M: -12.00%) BELOW TREND, TCELL (1W: -0.48% | 1M: +1.77%) CORRECTION.

## STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
HALKB (1W: +11.01% | 1M: +4.15%) ABOVE TREND, TRMET (1W: +8.47% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND, TRALT (1W: +7.82% | 1M: +17.20%) ABOVE TREND, EKGYO (1W: +6.13% | 1M: +13.19%) ABOVE TREND, OYAKC (1W: +5.67% | 1M: +10.41%) ABOVE TREND.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
ULKER (1W: -5.68% | 1M: +2.73%) CORRECTION, KONTR (1W: -5.32% | 1M: -12.00%) BELOW TREND, TKFEN (1W: -4.98% | 1M: +45.56%) CORRECTION, ALARK (1W: -4.07% | 1M: +4.83%) CORRECTION, TUPRS (1W: -3.92% | 1M: +29.47%) CORRECTION.

6. Momentum Stocks?
High-momentum names: HALKB (1W: +11.01% | 1M: +4.15%) ABOVE TREND, TRMET (1W: +8.47% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND, TRALT (1W: +7.82% | 1M: +17.20%) ABOVE TREND, EKGYO (1W: +6.13% | 1M: +13.19%) ABOVE TREND, ENKAI (1W: +5.60% | 1M: -1.13%) RECOVERY.

## SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Banking Sector Outlook?
Banking constructive; AKBNK (1W: +4.05% | 1M: +11.17%) ABOVE TREND, GARAN (1W: +0.98% | 1M: +4.63%) ABOVE TREND, ISCTR (1W: +3.03% | 1M: +0.70%) ABOVE TREND — momentum favors overweight on large-cap banks.

8. Industrial Sector Outlook?
Industrial mix: EREGL (1W: +2.49% | 1M: -11.76%) RECOVERY, FROTO (1W: +0.25% | 1M: +2.58%) ABOVE TREND, ENKAI (1W: +5.60% | 1M: -1.13%) RECOVERY — selective exposure to cyclical names advised.

9. Energy & Chemicals Outlook?
Energy showing selective strength but choppy: TRALT (1W: +7.82% | 1M: +17.20%) ABOVE TREND, TRMET (1W: +8.47% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND, TUPRS (1W: -3.92% | 1M: +29.47%) CORRECTION — overweight on refiner/chemical recovery trades with tight stops.

## PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Risk-ON: overweight Banking & selective Energy and Construction/REIT, trim Retail and Technology exposure; keep stops tight on names showing 1W weakness despite strong 1M gains.

## NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
HALKB (1W: +11.01% | 1M: +4.15%) ABOVE TREND for continuation or profit-taking, TUPRS (1W: -3.92% | 1M: +29.47%) CORRECTION for mean-reversion vs oil, TKFEN (1W: -4.98% | 1M: +45.56%) CORRECTION for earnings/cycle readthrough, SAHOL (1W: +3.98% | 1M: +7.56%) ABOVE TREND for holding-level strength.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
Banking & Finance, Energy & Chemicals, Construction & REIT for leadership and earnings/capital flow confirmation.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch XU100 for continuation above the recent swing high (momentum confirmation) or a break below the 20-day MA (risk warning); key triggers: domestic policy statements, CPI/PMI prints, FX moves and oil price swings, major earnings reports from banks and refineries.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
Risk-on market: low volatility (15.9%) and broad breadth (6/8). Banks and selective energy/construction are the tradeable leaders; retail and tech remain the weakest pockets and deserve underweight or strict stops. Main risk: any shift in FX/CBRT signals or global risk sentiment that erodes the current momentum.
